full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 53
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Friday, Bhadra 26, 2083
1:00 PM
1. Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the details of the letter received from the Office of the President regarding the appointment of ministers.
2. Information on Message
Mr. Prakash Adhikari, Secretary of the House of Representatives, will provide information regarding the "Bill to Amend the Provisions Relating to the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042" (Bill No. 2083) received as a message from the National Assembly.
3. Management Work
The Honorable Minister of Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, will present a proposal for consideration of the "Employees Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. The Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present a proposal for consideration of the "Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary General
